# Security Policy

## Supported scope

The default branch of this repository is the supported version of the MNL-NOX profile and static portfolio.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not publish exploitable details in a public issue. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature for this repository when it is enabled. If private reporting is unavailable, contact the maintainer through the email address published on the GitHub profile and include:

- Affected file, workflow or endpoint
- Impact and realistic attack scenario
- Reproduction steps or a minimal proof of concept
- Suggested mitigation, if known

Do not include credentials, personal data or third-party secrets in a report.

## Response expectations

Reports will be triaged as time and impact permit. Please allow reasonable time for investigation and remediation before public disclosure.

## Scope and authorization

Only test this repository, its published website and infrastructure you own or are explicitly authorized to assess. Do not attempt credential theft, destructive testing, denial of service or access to private systems.
